sources.entry: GitBlamePR - Mac app that shows pull request last modified each line of a file

summary.one_liner: A SwiftUI Mac app that shows, for each line of a file, the pull request that last modified it.
summary.what_it_does: GitBlamePR is a macOS app written in SwiftUI that displays git blame information mapped to pull requests, so each line of a file shows the pull request that last changed it. It bundles an Xcode Source Editor Extension so files open in Xcode can be sent to the app. It also defines a gitblamepr:// URL scheme that opens a specified file path, which can be called from the command line with the open command. The README describes installation as downloading the latest release, unzipping it, and running the app.
use_cases: see which pull request last changed a line of code
trace code history back to its pull request
open the current Xcode file in a blame viewer
open a file in a blame viewer from the terminal
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page
Optional: set a key binding for the Xcode Source Editor Extension action
Optional: open a file from the command line with open gitblamepr://{fileFullPath}
notable: Shows pull request attribution per line, not just the commit as plain git blame does
Xcode Source Editor Extension bundled in the app
gitblamepr:// URL scheme for opening files from scripts or the shell
caveats: The README does not describe how pull requests are matched to lines or which hosting services are supported
The README is brief and does not state a license
keywords: find pull request for a line
